content.String:
The power went out again. The generator is in the west wing.

I need to restore power before I can unlock the emergency exit.

The exit controls are in the main hall, but they won't work without power.

I keep hearing things in the walls...

Something is down here with us.

Don't stay in the dark too long.

EMERGENCY PROTOCOL:

1. Restore power via generator lever (West Wing)
2. Return to Main Hall
3. Pull exit lever to unlock emergency exit (South)

The exit lever requires power to function.

Don't go to the lower levels. Don't follow the sounds.

If you find this note, get out while you still can.

- M. Richter

Pull the lever to restore emergency power.

Once power is restored, the exit controls in the main hall will function.

WARNING: Generator may attract unwanted attention.
